result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Company may terminate on 30 days’ notice, receives a refund of prepaid amounts attributable to the post-termination period, owes no Termination Payment, and HDI is limited to end-of-term non-renewal. However, granting termination “in whole or in part” is unnecessary and materially broader than the playbook, potentially affecting unrelated scope and fee mechanics. The drafting also would be cleaner if it directly conformed Section 4.1 and subsection (a), rather than leaving facially inconsistent termination provisions in place and relying on Section 4.1A to override them.
